---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sudhir Kr. Roy, Advocate For the State : Mr. N. K. Gaunjhu, A.P.P
---------
 th
02/Dated: 16 January, 2024
1.

The applicant-lady, who is in custody since 29.09.2023, has approached this Court for grant of
regular bail in connection with Giridih (Muffasil) P.S. Case No.291 of 2020, registered for the
offence under Sections 498A/ 304B of the Indian Penal code and the cognizance has been taken
under Sections 306/ 34 of the I.P.C., pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Giridih.
2.  Learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission to withdraw the present bail application with a liberty to approach this Court after framing of the charge.
3. Learned counsel for the State has no objection.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
